data.name: Acre of the Devil
data.detailed_description:
Acre of the Devil is a single-player, top-down action shooter set in a corrupted Western frontier where violence, mystery, and decay rule what remains of civilization.

You explore hostile locations overrun by enemies, navigate interconnected levels, and survive intense combat encounters while uncovering the dark truth behind a spreading curse. The game focuses on deliberate gunplay, tactical movement, environmental interaction, and story-driven exploration.

Key Features

Top-Down Action Combat
Engage in fast, precise top-down shooting with responsive controls. Face multiple enemy types that pressure positioning, timing, and awareness rather than mindless rushing.

Dark Western Atmosphere
A grim, stylized world inspired by Western horror. Abandoned towns, mines, outposts, and forgotten sanctuaries tell their stories through lighting, sound, and environmental detail.

Exploration & Objectives
Levels are built around progression through exploration. Find keys, unlock safeboxes, open sealed paths, use tools like dynamite, and solve simple environmental challenges to advance.

Story Told Through the World
Narrative is delivered through environmental storytelling, lore notes, and subtle world details rather than cutscene overload. The world explains itself if you pay attention.

Single-Player, Offline Experience
Designed as a focused solo experience with no multiplayer, no live-service systems, and no distractions. Play at your own pace.

Stylized Visual Identity
A distinct visual style combining realistic environments with gritty, stylized presentation inspired by modern dark action titles.

Genre

Action, Top-Down Shooter, Western, Horror

Player Mode

Single-Player

data.short_description: Acre of the Devil is a single-player top-down action shooter set in a dark, decaying Western world. Fight relentless enemies, explore atmospheric locations, solve environmental objectives, and uncover a grim story told through gameplay and world design.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 X64
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-760 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050
  • Storage: 14 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains frequent depictions of violence against zombie enemies. Combat includes the use of firearms and melee weapons, with visual effects such as blood splatter, headshots, and dismemberment (e.g., limbs separating from zombie characters). These depictions are stylized within a fictional, undead context.

The game does not contain sexual content, sexual assault, self-harm, or references to drug or alcohol abuse. Violence is the primary mature element and is presented as part of fast-paced action gameplay against non-human enemies.
